neighbours.label: The word piece 'appy' / 'uffy' right after ' scr' (scrappy, scruffy); not happy, fluffy or other -appy/-uffy words
fire: Everyone loved the scrappy little terrier that guarded the shop.
A scruffy man in a torn jacket asked for directions.
Their offense was weak, but the scrappy defense kept them in the game.
My brother came home from camp looking scruffy and sunburned.
It started as a scrappy startup working out of a garage.
She adopted a scruffy grey cat from the shelter.
The underdogs played a scrappy match and earned a draw.
His beard was scruffy and his shoes were worn through.
quiet: Everyone loved the happy little terrier that guarded the shop.
A stuffy man in a pressed jacket asked for directions.
Their offense was weak, but the snappy passing kept them in the game.
My brother came home from camp looking puffy and sunburned.
It started as a scrap yard working out of a garage.
She adopted a fluffy grey cat from the shelter.
The underdogs played a sloppy match and earned a draw.
His beard was shaggy and his shoes were worn through.

notes: Low-max early-layer pole (max 5.5, card flags the gate-closed regime at 89%). Probes: scrappy 0.80, scruffy 0.58; ' suspect' 0.01 although it is in the card's top tokens; happy/fluffy/chunky 0.01.
